I have generated the dated visual study reproducing the observed BMW M official homepage (`https://www.bmw-m.com/en/index.html`, 2026-10-06 candidate baseline) at 1280px desktop resolution.

### Architectural & Visual Highlights
- **Authentic Brand Hierarchy**: Integrated the top 9px M Tricolor ribbon, shadowed `#262626` floating navbar with the combined BMW M roundel & tri-color badge, two-line *"The Ultimate Driving Machine"* motto, and official navigation items.
- **Asymmetric Hero Section**: Reconstructed the measured layout with the 3-line light H1 (`THE BMW 3 SERIES / PERFORMANCE / MODELS.`), left-aligned caption, `#3466cc` rectangular CTA button (*Experience now*), the authentic M350 xDrive red hero photograph, and overlapping portrait media badge.
- **All Core Sections & Original Content**:
  - Double teaser banners (*"THE 100 JAHRE NÜRBURGRING EDITION"* and *"YOUR ULTIMATE BMW M EXPERIENCE"*).
  - **BMW M Magazine Carousel**: Complete with all 7 authentic articles (*SHARPER LOOK, MORE POWER.*, *BODYWORK WITH CHARACTER.*, *FROM APRIL FOOL’S JOKE TO NÜRBURGRING HERO.*, etc.) with functional smooth-scrolling horizontal navigation controls.
  - **MORE NEW M MODELS**: Asymmetric portrait showcase covering the X5 M60e, M2, M760e, i7 M70, XM Label, and M2 CS.
  - **Editorial & Feature Blocks**: Street League Skateboarding, natural fibre composites in motorsport, split BMW M Lifestyle collection block, and centered BMW M Chatbot conversational card.
  - **More BMW M (8 original entries)**: Complete 8-card grid covering M Driving Experience, M Performance Parts, BMW M Individual, M Motorsport, Classic M Heritage, M Track Days, M Community, and BMW Esports.
  - Paired teasers (*THE ULTIMATE TOURING* and *ENTRY FOR EXPERTS*), Newsletter callout, and 4-column dark footer with English/Deutsch language options.
- **Interactive Controls**: Functional horizontal carousel scrolling controls, plus a mobile overlay menu triggered by the hamburger icon with `Escape` key dismissal support.

*Note: The study remains a candidate visual reproduction until verified against a live browser comparison.*
